comment: Maps per-section music energy onto difficulty, function and intensity. High energy means MORE complexity, density and layering -- not faster objects.

energyBands.name: LOW
energyBands.comment: Lower density, simpler patterns, larger recovery windows, lower visual intensity.

energyBands.name: MID
energyBands.comment: Normal density, moderate difficulty, longer sequences.

energyBands.name: HIGH
energyBands.comment: Greater complexity, density, pattern combinations, long chains, stronger visuals.

energyBands.name: PEAK
energyBands.comment: Layering and pattern length first; raw speed is not the tool.

difficultyFromEnergy.comment: Difficulty = weighted energy plus rhythm density; density adds complexity beyond loudness.

progression.comment: The difficulty curve across sections: gentle ramp, one climax, optional rest afterwards.

patternMatch.comment: How closely a pattern's difficulty must match the section target.
